source.label: RunPod pricing page
source.how_seen: read page by an agent via curl

other_prices_seen: Hyperstack lists an A100 PCIe at $1.40 an hour and RunPod's community cloud lists one from $1.19, but those pages carry no date or are not on-demand, so the tiers above use RunPod's dated on-demand prices. Vast.ai and Lambda prices could not be read.
caveats: A rented data-centre GPU is much faster than a used card, so hours of renting are not hours of equal work.
It leaves out electricity (see Running cost), the rest of the box, storage and bandwidth fees, and your own time.
Rental prices move often; this is one provider on one day.
